Subject: QBR pre-read: capacity planning & GPU unit-econ — decisions needed

Team,

Attached is a concise pre-read for next week’s QBR slot (see qbr-one-pager-gpu-econ.pdf and capacity_model_v2.xlsx). Goals for this thread:

- Lock the runway decision for Q1 (do we absorb 20% extra demand or buy burst capacity?)
- Agree the vendor quote tolerance so procurement can sign (AsterCloud provided a draft)
- Prioritize which experiments we run pre-QBR to demonstrate batching/caching impact on unit cost

High-level TL;DR:
- Our baseline GPU unit cost (current mix) = $0.015 / token equivalent for gen workloads (see tab ‘baseline’).
- If we enable continuous prefix caching + 2x batching we estimate a 28–34% unit-cost reduction for targeted routes (chat-heavy product flows).
- Tradeoffs: cold-start latency increases for very low-QPS endpoints; autoscaler settings need a 10–12 min warm buffer.

Asks (please reply inline):
1) Leadership decision: commit to 10% reserved burst with AsterCloud vs. one-off spot runs. We need yes/no by 10/31 EOD.
2) Engineering: pick two routes to enable prefix caching canary (suggest: /chat/api and /summarize/doc) — who owns?
3) Ops: confirm impact on SLA (p50/p95) if we accept 12 min warm buffer.

Attachments: capacity_model_v2.xlsx (cost scenarios), qbr-one-pager-gpu-econ.pdf, vendor quote (astercloud-pricing-quote-1028.pdf).

Meeting: I’ll propose a 40-minute alignment on 11/02 to finalize the slides.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Director, Platform Economics
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: QBR pre-read: capacity planning & GPU unit-econ — decisions needed

Thanks Mina — solid pack. A few follow-ups / details I need before I can sign-off on runway: 

- Baseline assumptions: is the $0.015/token using the current mix of A100/NVLink instances + our quantized models? The model mix matters — please call out which model profiles are under ‘baseline’.
- Utilization curves: can we get a 24h P95 utilization slice (by pool) rather than the daily aggregate? Edge cases (midnight peaks driven by batch infer) change how many slots we keep warm.
- Batching/caching experiments: I want concrete perf targets we can measure in the next 10 days. For example: enable caching on /chat/api for 50% of traffic and show token-cost delta within 72h. We need automatic rollback if p95 latency degrades > 15%.

On vendor: if AsterCloud’s quote includes pre-provisioned slots with a 10% price reduction at 6-month commit, that is attractive. But we need a fallback plan if they can’t meet the 99.5% instance availability SLA.

Please reply inline to the three asks and include the updated capacity_model_v2.xlsx showing the model-mix assumptions.

- 6-month reserved slots: 10% discount vs. on-demand; 12-month lock reduces price further by 18%.

Quick consolidation and decisions — thanks for the fast replies.

Decisions taken (for QBR slides):
- Leadership: we will proceed with a 6-month 10% reserved burst with AsterCloud, conditional on adding the 99.5% SLA add-on and a 30-day opt-out clause. (Action: Lauren to loop Legal, due 11/06)
- Engineering owners: Aditya -> /chat/api canary; Marissa -> /summarize/doc canary. Engineering to enable prefix caching for 50% of traffic on those routes and report cost/latency delta in 72h. (Action: Aditya/Marissa, due 11/06)
- Ops: Accept 12 min warm buffer if the autoscaler policy includes an emergency fast-burst override (no more than 5% of traffic). Ops to publish updated SLO impact table. (Action: Vivek/Marissa, due 11/06)

Next steps:
1) Aditya/Marissa: run the canary and push a one-page results note into the shared Drive folder (link below) by 11/06.
2) Lauren: confirm vendor terms with Legal and post the signed DocuSign link here.
3) Mina: I’ll update the capacity_model_v2.xlsx with the final model-mix assumptions and include the vendor line in the QBR slide deck.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBR_PREP_GPU_ECON
